sections.content: Real data tables need structure: <caption> for titles, <thead>/<tbody>/<tfoot> for grouping, scope attributes on <th> to associate headers, and colspan/rowspan for merged cells.
Complex tables become unreadable fast — if you need nested tables or heavy merging, reconsider whether a list or cards layout serves users better.
Key points: caption describes the table, scope="col"/"row" links headers to cells for screen readers, and zebra striping is CSS, not HTML.
